title.narrative: Supporting AfriMAB network as changemaker for sustainability in Africa

description.narrative:
Subject to the availability of additional contributions from AfriMAB members, partners, and donors, this workplan will support the implementation of AfriMAB priorities by providing institutional, technical, and coordination support to the MAB Programme and biosphere reserves across Africa. It will seek to unlock and strengthen the potential of biosphere reserves as drivers of transformative Nature–Society–Development solutions that contribute to biodiversity conservation, ecosystem restoration, climate resilience, sustainable livelihoods, and inclusive local development.
Key activities will include support to regional thematic priorities and field-based initiatives, capacity-development and knowledge-sharing activities, and the strengthening of cooperation with the African Union, Regional Economic Communities, and other strategic partners. Efforts will also be pursued to enhance the visibility and effectiveness of the AfriMAB Network, strengthen regional cooperation, and mobilize sustainable financial and technical resources to support the long-term development of biosphere reserves and the Network as a whole.
Through these actions, the workplan will contribute to strengthening AfriMAB as a platform for cooperation, innovation, peer learning, and the exchange of good practices in support of the objectives of the MAB Strategy and Action Plan (2025–2035), UNESCO's Priority Africa, and the African Union's Agenda 2063. \
